articles.title: Hong Kong’s leader apologises for residential fire that killed 168 people
articles.highlight: 香港特首就政府不足导致去年造成168人死亡的火灾道歉，但部分遇难者家属并不买账。
articles.summary: 文章报道香港特首李家超等官员就政府机构“数十年失误”导致的住宅火灾公开鞠躬道歉；这场火灾造成168人死亡，是1980年以来全球最致命的住宅火灾。报道同时指出，部分幸存者和遇难者家属认为正义尚未得到伸张，道歉未能令他们满意。这则新闻值得关注，因为它呈现了官方罕见公开认错与受害者家属追问责任之间的紧张关系。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：公开道歉可以体现问责姿态；但如果缺乏后续责任追究与制度修正，就难以满足受害者家属对正义的期待。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Blaze was world’s deadliest residential fire since 1980, but some survivors and bereaved families say justice has yet to be served Hong Kong’s leader has apologised for government shortcomings that contributed to a fire that killed 168 people in the city last year, a rare sign of public contrition that nevertheless failed to impress some victims’ families. The chief executive, John Lee, and seven other officials bowed in apology at the release of a report that pointed to “decades of failure” by government bodies.

en.highlight: Hong Kong’s leader apologised for government shortcomings that contributed to a fire that killed 168 people last year, but some victims’ families were not impressed.
en.summary: The article reports that Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee and other officials bowed in apology after a report pointed to “decades of failure” by government bodies behind a residential fire that killed 168 people, the world’s deadliest such fire since 1980. articles.title: Should You Study The Solutions Or Solve Problems?
articles.highlight: 哪种学习方法能带来更通用的学习效果，让你在遇到新类型问题时表现更好？
articles.summary: 文章从一个课堂问题集的场景切入：直接研究答案，还是自己解题，哪种方式更能带来可迁移的学习效果。它强调学习需要努力，但并非所有努力都有助于学习，因此值得读者反思自己的练习方式。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键不是是否努力，而是努力是否服务于可迁移的理解；选练习方式时，应优先考虑能否在新问题上表现更好。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Watch the video of this essay. Learning requires effort. But not all effort is useful for learning.

en.highlight: Which method would result in more general learning, letting you perform better on new types of problems?

articles.title: The physics of getting fired

articles.summary: 作者扎汉·巴马尔谈到，物理学曾给他秩序感与目标感；生活变得混乱后，他发现物理学还能提供更深层的洞见。文章以“被解雇”为入口，讨论科学视角如何帮助人理解现实中的杂乱与失序，适合想借科学思维获得生活启发的人阅读。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键要点是：物理学的价值不只在给出秩序，也可能在生活失序时提供重新理解处境的心智框架。

articles.title: Building a multiplayer game world with autonomous Fable-class models
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 这篇文章是 Jacob Sansbury 讲述他们如何打造 Spawn：一个大型多人在线游戏环境，玩家可用提示让游戏内智能体 Savi 直接改造游戏世界（例如生成城堡、龙并骑龙飞行）。其开发由一群 Fable 驱动的智能体自主完成，每月 token 支出超过 300 万美元（约为人力成本的 30 倍）；约 60% 的工作源自线上错误、Savi 提交的 bug、日志异常或功能请求，一小时内没有发布被视为最高级别的 SEV-0 事故，故障可在 30 秒内精确回滚。作者认为这类极端实验正是探索当今编码智能体能力边界的有价值试验场。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键约束在模型选择与工程配套：Jacob 称 Fable 5（及 5.1）才让这种自主程度成为可能，Opus 5.5 尚不够用，而 GPT-6 Astra 在执行安全审查修复时把每个功能都关掉了；同时这种循环依赖极快的发布节奏来让智能体保持连贯。
articles.highlight: 我们的智能体直接修改线上代码，每小时发布到生产环境，因此它们自己读取每一个错误、bug 报告和指标。
articles.sourceExcerpt: How I Built the Most AI-Pilled Company in the World Don't be put off by the clickbait headline, this piece by Jacob Sansbury describing how they are building Spawn is a fascinating exploration of the bleeding edge of what's possible with agentic engineering against frontier models. Spawn is a massively multiplayer gaming environment where players can use prompts (to the in-game agent, Savi) to modify the game world. I fired it up on my phone for a few minutes and was able to prompt a castle into existence, then a dragon, then ride the dragon to fly around that castle.

en.highlight: Our agents change the live code directly and ship to production hourly, so they read every error, bug report and metric themselves.
en.summary: Jacob Sansbury describes Spawn, a massively multiplayer gaming environment where players prompt an in-game agent, Savi, to modify the world — the author prompted a castle, a dragon, and rode the dragon around it. Development is largely autonomous: a swarm of Fable-powered agents costs over $3 million in tokens per month, roughly 60% of work starts from a production error, Savi bug report, log anomaly or feature request, and an hour without a ship is treated as a SEV-0 incident with 30-second targeted rollbacks. The author finds this a valuable substrate for probing the limits of today's coding agents.
en.failureAnalysis: Model choice and engineering scaffolding are the binding constraints: Jacob says Fable 5 (then 5.1) made this autonomy possible, Opus 5.5 falls short, and GPT-6 Astra disabled every feature while applying security-review fixes; the loop also depends on shipping faster than an agent's few-hour working memory.
